```{r}
#| output: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

# Load all packages listed in DESCRIPTION
devtools::install_deps(upgrade = "never")
devtools::load_all()
```

```{r}
# Get read/write folders
read_folder <- here::here("data", "csv-files")
fig_folder <- here::here("figures")
```

## Read data

First, we read data from the OdonTraits database.

```{r}
datlist <- list()

# List files names
files <- list.files(read_folder)
# Omit column metadata and species taxonomy
files <- files[!(files %in% c("column_description.csv", 
                              "sources.csv",
                              "references.csv",
                              "taxonomic.csv"))]

# Read files
for(i in seq_along(files)) {
  dat <- read.csv(file.path(read_folder, files[i]), 
                  sep = ",")
  datlist[[i]] <- dat
}

datnames <- gsub(files, pattern = "\\.csv$", replacement = "")
names(datlist) <- datnames

# Read taxonomy
taxo <- read.csv(file.path(read_folder, "taxonomic.csv"), sep = ",")
```

The next step is to merge tables.

```{r}
# List to dataframe
df <- Reduce(function(...) merge(..., by = 'species_name', 
                                 all.x = TRUE), datlist)
```

## Format data

Replace "missing" Red List criteria with "-" when it means species were assessed but not threatened:
```{r} 
df$redlist_2024_criteria[is.na(df$redlist_2024_criteria) & !is.na(df$redlist_2024_category)] <- "-"

df$eu27_redlist_2024_criteria[is.na(df$eu27_redlist_2024_criteria) & !is.na(df$eu27_redlist_2024_category)] <- "-"
```

## Plot

Below we prepare data for the plot:
```{r}
# Get only traits (remove species name)
traits_df <- df[, 2:ncol(df)]

# Get coverage for each trait
traits_coverage <- apply(traits_df, 2, 
                         function(x) sum(!is.na(x))/nrow(traits_df)*100)

traits_coverage_df <- data.frame(trait = names(traits_coverage),
                                 coverage = traits_coverage)

# Get traits categories
traits_categories <- lapply(datlist, colnames)
traits_categories_df <- stack(traits_categories)
colnames(traits_categories_df) <- c("trait", "category")

# Convert to data.table for merge
traits_coverage_df <- data.table::as.data.table(traits_coverage_df)
traits_categories_df <- data.table::as.data.table(traits_categories_df)

# Merge
traits_coverage_df <- traits_categories_df[traits_coverage_df,
                                           on = "trait"]

# Change the order of trait categories
traits_coverage_df[, category := factor(category,
                                        levels = c("imago", "larvae_exuvia", "ecological",
                                                   "protection_endemism", "conservation"))]
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| code-fold: true

labeller <- c("protection_endemism" = "Protection and endemism",
              "imago" = "Imago morphology",
              "larvae_exuvia" = "Larvae/exuviae morphology",
              "ecological" = "Ecological traits",
              "conservation" = "Conservation")

ggplot(traits_coverage_df,
       aes(y = trait, 
           x = coverage)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(round(coverage, 1), "%")), 
            size = 3,
            hjust = 1.1, col = "white") +
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(category), 
             labeller = as_labeller(labeller),
             scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  xlab("Trait coverage (%)") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(fig_folder, "trait_coverage.png"),
       width = 32, height = 18, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```

Let's do the same by species
```{r}
# Get coverage for each species
traits_coverage_sp <- apply(traits_df, 1, 
                            function(x) sum(!is.na(x))/ncol(traits_df)*100)

traits_coverage_sp_df <- data.frame(species_name = df$species_name,
                                    coverage = traits_coverage_sp)

# Convert to data.table for merge
traits_coverage_sp_df <- data.table::as.data.table(traits_coverage_sp_df)
taxo <- data.table::as.data.table(taxo)

# Merge
traits_coverage_sp_df <- taxo[traits_coverage_sp_df,
                              on = "species_name"]

# Family to factor
nfam <- table(taxo$family)

traits_coverage_sp_df[, family2 := family]

# Get family threshold
thr <- 4
other_name <- "Other families"
traits_coverage_sp_df[, family2:= ifelse(nfam[family2] < thr, 
                                         other_name, family2)]

famorder <- names(sort(nfam[nfam >= thr], 
                       decreasing = TRUE))
famorder <- c(famorder, other_name)
traits_coverage_sp_df[, family2 := factor(family2, famorder)]

# create dummy column to separate plots
fam <- levels(traits_coverage_sp_df$family2)
col <- c(1, 2, 2, rep(3, length(fam) - 3))
names(col) <- fam
traits_coverage_sp_df[, col:= col[family2]]

# sporder <- sort(traits_coverage_sp_df$species_name, 
#                 decreasing = TRUE)
# traits_coverage_sp_df[, species_name := factor(species_name, sporder)]
```


```{r}
family2 <- levels(traits_coverage_sp_df$family2)
df_img <- data.table(family2)

df_img[, uuid := c("6c95d27a-ce71-43b0-a42c-6acab75a9967", # Libellulidae
                   "516df51a-adc7-4cfc-86b9-9954698bd5ed", # Coenagrionidae
                   "36543d34-f5d6-48a1-818f-eca72bfe1a19", # Aeshnidae
                   "ba61ce1b-b940-433b-a573-5e338ca4ef87", # Gomphidae
                   "ce57b692-e1e0-468e-a025-8c10ceebca22", # Corduliidae
                   "f171f690-d5b3-4cf0-a8a3-8d615abcad34", # Lestidae
                   "f9f40ed4-c092-4456-aade-acf36174dfdd", # Cordulegastridae
                   "8af9c80d-92f9-4ba8-87c0-8ffa026c770c", # Calopterygidae
                   "371dccbd-688f-462c-b337-a5c17561158b", # Platycnemididae
                   "546c0612-c80c-4f61-bcd1-93eabbc5eda0" # Other spp -> Macromia splendens
                   )]

# Get Phylopic images
img <- lapply(df_img$uuid, rphylopic::get_phylopic,
              format = "vector")

# Get attribution
attribution <- rphylopic::get_attribution(uuid = df_img$uuid,
                                          text = TRUE)
attribution$text <- paste("# Attribution", attribution$text, sep = "\n")
# Write to file
writeLines(attribution$text, 
           con = file(here::here("data", "phylopic", "README.md")))

# Get filenames
filenames <- here::here("data", 
                        "phylopic", 
                        paste0(df_img$family2, ".png"))
res <- lapply(seq_along(img),
       function(i) {
         png(filenames[i], 
             width = 500, 
             height = 400, bg = NA)
         plot(img[[i]])
         dev.off()
         # png::writePNG(img[[i]], asp = 1,
         #               target = filenames[i])
         invisible(NULL)
       })


# Add filename
df_img[, filename := filenames]

# Get Markdown text
h <- 15
df_img[, img := paste0("<span>", family2, " </span>",
                       "<img src = '",
                       filename, "' height='", h, "'/>")]
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| code-fold: true

# Create labeller for corresponding Markdown code and families
labeller <- df_img$img
names(labeller) <- df_img$family2

# Reorder species by coverage within each column 
# (break ties with alphabetical order)
data.table::setorder(traits_coverage_sp_df, 
                     col, coverage, -species_name)
traits_coverage_sp_df[, species_name := factor(species_name,
                                               levels = species_name)]
# Base plots
g1 <- ggplot(subset(traits_coverage_sp_df, col == 1))
g2 <- ggplot(subset(traits_coverage_sp_df, col == 2))
g3 <- ggplot(subset(traits_coverage_sp_df, col == 3))

(g1 + g2 + g3) &
  patchwork::plot_layout(axes = "collect") &
  geom_col(aes(y = species_name, 
               x = coverage)) &
  geom_text(aes(y = species_name,
                x = coverage,
                label = paste(round(coverage, 1), "%")),
  size = 2.5,
  hjust = 1.1, col = "white") &
  ggforce::facet_col(facets = vars(family2),
                     labeller = as_labeller(labeller),
                     scales = "free_y",
                     space = "free") &
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0, 3)) &
  theme_bw((base_size = 12)) &
  xlab("Trait coverage (%)") &
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))

ggsave(file.path(fig_folder, "spp_trait_coverage.png"),
       width = 30, height = 24, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```
